visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman is dressed in a fantasy cosplay costume featuring a short white wig adorned with a small flower and long, pointed prosthetic elf ears. She wears a vibrant green cloak over a teal and white dress with gold accents. She stands in a lush outdoor park with tall green trees and bright, natural sunlight filtering through the leaves. She holds a large, stylized spear made of translucent blue material with ornate gold carvings. (2) The camera transitions to a tight close-up shot focusing on the character's face. Her eyes are large and brown with detailed makeup, and her expression is calm and attentive. The background bokeh blurs the park scenery, emphasizing her facial features and the texture of her white hair. She remains static while looking directly into the lens. (3) The subject brings her hands into the frame, crossing her index fingers to create a distinct "X" symbol in front of her collarbone. Her hands are adorned with gold metallic gauntlets or cuffs. She maintains her steady gaze toward the camera, emphasizing the gesture against the soft green background of the park. (4) A digital overlay or physical prop of a black "X" appears over the woman's mouth, symbolizing silence. Large, bold white text reading "OxO" is displayed at the bottom of the frame. Her head tilts slightly, but her eyes remain fixed on the viewer as the lighting remains bright and natural. (5) The character holds up a small, round yellow cake with a caramelized top, resting in a plastic container. A purple candle in the shape of the number "7" is placed in the center of the cake. She continues to wear the black "X" over her mouth while presenting the cake to the camera in the sunlit outdoor setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A youthful female voice speaks with a bright, energetic tone, counting down in Japanese: "San, Ni, Ichi, Go" (3, 2, 1, Go). The speech rate is moderate and rhythmic. Beneath the voice, a high-tempo electronic beat begins to build, characterized by a sharp, crisp snare and a pulsing bassline with a high arousal level. (2) A loud, distorted "bass drop" or transition sound effect triggers a change in the musical texture. The background music shifts into a repetitive, high-intensity Phonk-style rhythm with heavy distortion and a fast BPM. The vocal track ends, leaving only the aggressive electronic percussion and deep synth layers. (3) The music maintains a constant, high-energy beat with strong percussive transients and bright spectral weight. There are no ambient noises or incidental sounds; the audio is perfectly clean and post-produced. The rhythmic structure is rigid, providing a consistent, driving momentum until the video concludes.
